objective.label: Hold Mont-Saint-Jean for 5:00 until the Prussians arrive.

battlefield.note: The ridge of Mont-Saint-Jean with the forest of Soignes behind it, Hougoumont and La Haye Sainte forward, a muddy valley and La Belle Alliance on the French rise.

popup.title: Waterloo: Hold the Ridge
popup.body:
You command Wellington's army on the ridge of Mont-Saint-Jean. Napoleon will throw corps after corps at you across the muddy valley: first at Hougoumont, then at your centre, then with his cavalry and finally the Imperial Guard. Keep your line on the crest, where the slope and the volleys give it the advantage; Hougoumont and La Haye Sainte are forward posts that cost the French time and men. Blücher's Prussians are coming from the east; hold Mont-Saint-Jean until they arrive.

Objective: Hold Mont-Saint-Jean for 5:00 until the Prussians arrive.

On 18 June 1815 Wellington's Anglo-allied army held the ridge at Mont-Saint-Jean against repeated French attacks until Blücher's Prussians arrived on Napoleon's flank. The defeat of the Imperial Guard ended Napoleon's rule.

popup.title: Reille attacks Hougoumont
popup.body: French infantry is advancing through the wood on Hougoumont. The Guards must hold the château.

popup.title: D'Erlon's grand attack
popup.body: A whole French corps is crossing the valley toward La Haye Sainte and your centre.

popup.title: The cavalry charges
popup.body: Marshal Ney leads the French cavalry against your line. Hold the crest; infantry in good order can see them off.

popup.title: The Imperial Guard
popup.body: Napoleon commits the Imperial Guard against Mont-Saint-Jean. This is the last French attack.

popup.title: The Prussians arrive
popup.body: Blücher's Prussians are coming out of the Bois de Paris onto the French flank.
